# Recreation Prompt

Recreate `Cloudberry Slaycare RPG` as a single-file browser-native mobile portrait game. Preserve the source mechanics exactly: top-down joystick movement, directional light attack by tapping the playfield, held heavy attack, dodge roll with cooldown and brief invulnerability, escalating enemy waves from screen edges, contact damage, HP failure overlay, currency-driven level growth, loot items that affect attack bonuses, inventory/equipment selection, weapon unlock thresholds at 10/20/32 kills, and restart.

Transform the public identity into a cozy satirical life-simulator RPG inspired by gentle countryside animation: Momo, a cloud-hat planner mage, tidies burnout blobs, deadline moths, doomscroll wisps, rent goblins, and inbox leeches in a rainbow bathhouse garden. Use pixel-art readability, soft girl pastel panels, rainbowcore procedural background layers, meme-tone copy such as “slay” and “its giving organized,” and one-thumb iOS/Android portrait controls.
blueprint_markdown:
# Blueprint

## Source Game Truth
- genre: Mobile-first top-down survival/action RPG with inventory and equipment progression.
- objective: Move a hero around the arena, defeat incoming monsters, earn currency, collect item drops, unlock stronger weapons, survive escalating waves, and restart after HP reaches zero.
- input model: Virtual joystick for movement, canvas tap for light attack, hold right action button for heavy attacks, right-side roll button for dodge, inventory button/items for equipment selection, keyboard shortcuts for desktop fallback.
- core loop: Spawn enemies from screen edges, enemies pursue using behavior variants, player attacks in facing direction, defeated enemies award score/currency/loot, currency raises loot level and healing, waves escalate by time.
- fail/friction state: Contact damage reduces HP with invulnerability cooldown; zero HP opens a game-over overlay with final stats and restart.

## Protected Mechanics
- Joystick movement magnitude, facing direction, boundary clamp, attack cooldowns/range/directional cone, roll cooldown/invulnerability/displacement, enemy spawn cadence, enemy behavior classes, contact damage, HP failure, currency-to-level threshold, loot item bonus, weapon unlock thresholds, inventory/equip gating, HUD progress reporting, and restart reset.

## Safe Theming Surfaces
HUD vocabulary, title/copy, procedural drawing, entity silhouettes, palette, background, pop-up text, button labels, inventory item names, weapon display names, audio labels, feedback GIF positioning, and document metadata are safe to transform because they do not alter gameplay truth.

## Target Remix Blueprint
Regenerate the same mechanics as “Cloudberry Slaycare RPG,” a cozy satirical life simulator where Momo, a cloud-hat planner mage, uses one-thumb controls to tidy burnout chores in a rainbow bathhouse garden. Hazards are stress chores, rewards are self-care items, gold is Glowcoins, level is Slay LV, failure is a vibe-check collapse, and visual progression moves from calm morning garden to denser rainbow night market energy.
